Name: (PFM) Easy Coal
Author: pancham138
Description:
Easily getting more coal when burning woods into Charcoal Kiln.
[list]
[*]1 Wood to get 1 Coal
[*]1 Hardwood to get 10 Coals (new in version 1.2.0)
[*]1 Driftwood to get 5-9 Coals (new in version 1.3.0)
[/list]
Requirements:
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM Automate[/url] required only if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ mod
[/list]
Configuration:
[list]
[*]If you think 1 wood is too easy, you can edit directly ProducerRules.json, then change the "InputStack" value to your choose.
[*]You can even modify the "MinutesUntilReady" value (in-game minutes) to your choose.
[/list]
Notes:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿ mod only works if you also installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM Automate[/url].
[*]This mod also works in [b]multiplayer[/b], you only need the host to install this mod.
[*]This mod also works in [b]multiplayer[/b] with [b]Automate [/b]and[b] PFMAutomate[/b] mod.
[/list]
Credits:[list]
[*]I can't thank enough the PFM author who made it easy for us to modify such simple recipe.
[/list]
